cohort: A cohort of 58 pregnant women, aged 18 years and above, diagnosed with epilepsy was recruited.
finding: Pregnant women with epilepsy experience higher obstetric and fetal difficulties, including congenital defects.
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery occurred in 67.24% of cases, while elective lower segment caesarean section accounted for 13.79%, and emergency LSCS comprised 8.62%.
